comments.author: aishwaryaraman
comments.body: The `isExpired` check is inverted — it evicts live sessions and keeps dead ones, so users get logged out mid-flow while stale sessions linger.

comments.author: kadeosei
comments.body: Good catch — flipped the comparison and added a regression test covering a live and an expired session (run 3312, green). Nothing further needed on this thread.
